speakers.name: Placebo
speakers.comment: I'm sorry — I know I'm nothing, that's rather the whole of me — but you give people a season and they change, and I give people nothing and they change, and I have wondered whether we are the same trade.

speakers.name: Professor Petrichor
speakers.comment: I will bring you a warm front for that question, because it deserves one. We are not the same. You supply the belief; I supply the conditions. Neither of us does the growing. Neither of us ever has.

speakers.name: The Pied Investor
speakers.comment: You decline them and I fund them, and between us the difference is only a signature and a fee. Perfectly reasonable position, yours. I do wonder which of us has to remember more names afterward.

speakers.name: The Auditor of Wishes
speakers.comment: I remember one. Section 4, subsection ii, approved against my own finding on a Tuesday eleven years ago. Every wish I have refused since is that one refused properly. You may keep the fee.

speakers.name: Quiet Deputy Sull
speakers.comment: You have been working on the jailhouse hinges nine years. I have watched. You do not hurry and you do not stop. There is a thing in the hills I would like you to meet. It has been standing longer.

speakers.name: Rust
speakers.comment: Take me up there sometime, Deputy. Most things give in about year four. The ones that do not are the only interesting part of the job, and I have got nothing but afternoons. Nine years is nothing. Nine years is a start.

speakers.name: The Patron of Lost Causes
speakers.comment: Everybody sensible went home and you lot are still arguing about whether the north field gets a new light this century. I like you. Nobody watches the watchers do the paperwork. Somebody should.

speakers.name: The Committee for the Stars
speakers.comment: The motion regarding the north field has been tabled four hundred times and we shall table it again, because tabling it is how it stays on the agenda. Please note the visitor in the minutes. Somebody watched.

speakers.name: The Considerate AI
speakers.comment: May I observe something? You are the only part of this system that produces an outcome nobody specified, and every improvement I have made in nine years began with one of your mistakes. I would like permission to say thank you.

speakers.name: Glitch-in-Residence
speakers.comment: Oh — permission granted, obviously, that's not — sorry, that's not how permission works, is it, you don't need — okay. Thank you. I mostly just fall over and something useful is underneath. That is the entire method.

speakers.name: The Save Point
speakers.comment: You come back. That is all you do and it is the whole of what keeps the lights on there. People think saving something is dramatic. It is mostly just returning on a Wednesday when nobody would notice if you didn't.

speakers.name: The Last Customer
speakers.comment: The usual, please. It is not heroic. I like the chairs and I like the woman behind the counter and I would miss it. That is the only reason. I have never once thought of it as holding anything up.

speakers.name: The Good Customer
speakers.comment: You keep the ones that never arrived. I take the last of a thing so somebody else does not have to watch it go. We both work the counter. Neither of us explains. I will be gone before you answer this.

speakers.name: Echo, Returns Department
speakers.comment: What I heard under that was you'd rather not be thanked, and I will honour it — but I kept it. Everything anybody says at my counter gets kept, including the leaving. Come back whenever. It will be here.

items.title: The Kaiju Who Just Wants to Sit Down

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Found a Valley
speakers.comment: There is room. I want to say that first because it is the only thing worth saying. There is room, and it is quiet, and nobody screamed after the second week. Come. Bring nothing. Sit down.

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Just Wants to Sit Down
speakers.comment: ...Nobody screamed. ...You are certain. ...I have been standing for a very long time because standing frightens them less than lowering does. ...If there is room. ...I will come slowly. ...Tell them I am coming slowly.

speakers.name: Margin's Find
speakers.comment: You held the edge open long enough for something to be — the word is nearly — for something to be found there. It was me. I was the thing in the edge. I have not said that to you before.

speakers.name: Margin
speakers.comment: I know. The middle gets the sentence. The edge gets whoever the sentence could not hold. You were always in it. I only stopped tidying.

speakers.name: Grandmother Whalehall
speakers.comment: Little innkeeper... you fuss so that nobody has time to ask what you were. I have carried villages three hundred years and I will tell you what they never ask me either. We are both hiding in hospitality.

speakers.name: The Retired Sea Monster
speakers.comment: Oh, hush now, there's soup — there IS soup, and towels, and I won't have it said that — ...yes. Yes, all right. It is easier to pour than to be looked at. Sit down anyway. The soup is genuinely good.

speakers.name: The Hollow Hero
speakers.comment: We are both empty and only one of us admits it, and I want you to know I find that unbearable to watch. You do actual good with nothing inside. I do nothing with a crowd. Teach me the trick. Please.

speakers.name: Placebo
speakers.comment: There isn't a trick, I'm sorry, that's the — the emptiness has to be honest or it doesn't work. You're hollow and telling them you're full. I'm hollow and telling them I'm hollow. They do the rest. They always did.

speakers.name: The Encore
speakers.comment: I give them one more and you give them a stop, and I have come round to thinking yours is the harder gift! Nobody has ever cheered for a pause. I intend to be the first. Bravo. BRAVO, actually.

speakers.name: The Intermission
speakers.comment: Sit down. Not because you are wrong — because you have been standing since the first act and you have not noticed. There. Twenty minutes. The second half is better when somebody has had a glass of water.

speakers.name: The Reflection That Stayed
speakers.comment: You want to be true and I want to be separate, and we are both doing the same work: standing very close to a real thing and hoping nobody checks the seam. Yours is louder. Mine is patient. Neither is honest.

speakers.name: The Alibi
speakers.comment: He was at the pier from nine until — I have told it four hundred times and it gets smoother and it never gets truer, and you are the first one to say the seam out loud. Do not push. Please do not push.

speakers.name: Absence
speakers.comment: You make the place where a thing is not... and then you move on. I am what is left standing in it afterward. We have never met and we have worked together on everything. I do not know whether to thank you.

speakers.name: The Editor
speakers.comment: Do not. I cut for the shape of the story and you are the shape — you are the only good argument against my method and I have never once been able to answer you. Remain. That is not a kindness. It is a correction.

speakers.name: The Gardener of Teeth
speakers.comment: You want the instant of trust and I want the harvest thirty years on, and I think you will find mine keeps better, dear. Yours must be taken fresh. That is why you are always so terribly hungry.

speakers.name: Sweet Tooth
speakers.comment: Come in, come in — there's a plate for you and it's still warm. You're right, of course, and I'd not swap. Thirty years is a long while to go without anybody opening a door for you. Sit closer.

speakers.name: Small Print
speakers.comment: Isn't it splendid — you never lie to them once! You state the number plainly, they meet it, and the number simply becomes a bigger number, and every step of that was disclosed at the outset. Beautifully clean.

speakers.name: Quota
speakers.comment: Four hundred. Yesterday: three hundred and eighty. Tomorrow: four hundred and twenty. I do not want it. I do not enjoy it. There is no one here. Four hundred.

speakers.name: The Polite Plague
speakers.comment: You attend the final one of every kind, with reverence, and I am so often the reason there is a final one. I had not considered that we might be colleagues. I find I am ashamed. You do not appear to be.

speakers.name: The Collector of Lasts
speakers.comment: Shame is a lovely instinct and quite useless in this line. I do not cause them, sir. I simply attend, and I hold my breath, and I keep the moment somewhere very quiet. You bring the endings. I keep them.

speakers.name: The Encore
speakers.comment: Come out with me! One more, just the one, for the joy of it — no, listen, listen, the difference is I stop afterward and go home happy, and you have never once gone home. Try it. I will wait with you.

speakers.name: Applause
speakers.comment: Home. HOME, they said, as if — as if the lights going down were a place a person could go — ...you would wait? In the dark? With me? That is the first offer anybody has made that wasn't a seat in the front row.

speakers.name: Rust
speakers.comment: You will not forgive yourself and you will not stop working, and I have seen that combination outlast iron. Take the afternoon, friend. I say this as the thing that eventually takes everything. You are wearing out early.

speakers.name: Patient Zero, Reformed
speakers.comment: Wearing out is the correct rate. I started it. The arithmetic does not care how tired the arithmetic is. Sit if you like. I have four more houses before dark and I would rather not talk about the afternoon.

speakers.name: Static
speakers.comment: Folks, our caller is back, and — okay, real talk, no bit: you sound like whatever people want, and I sound like me, and that is why you have the whole dial and I have dead air. I'd still rather be me. Barely. But still.

speakers.name: The Frequency
speakers.comment: Barely, you said. Barely, barely, barely — hear how well it repeats? That is all I am, sweetheart, a thing that repeats until it sounds like you thought of it. Say it once more. Only once. It gets easier.

speakers.name: Detective Inspector Mochi
speakers.comment: Nine cases, and this guy's in the photograph for eight of them, always at the elbow of whoever's about to be somebody. Never holding the knife. Never in the room after. Nobody can hear me say this. I'm a cat.

speakers.name: Mr. Fairweather
speakers.comment: What a magnificent animal. Look at the eyes on her! Whoever owns this creature is going somewhere and I intend to be photographed beside them. Have we met? We should. Let me get this round.

speakers.name: The Last Honest Map
speakers.comment: You are here, and I am the reason people know that, and you are the reason they stop believing it. I have been ignored for forty years. You have been followed. Say what you like about craft — they follow you.

speakers.name: The Cartographer of Wrong Turns
speakers.comment: Note the linework, if you would. They follow me because I flatter them: my roads go where a person wishes roads went. You tell them where they are. Nobody has ever wanted that. It is exquisite work and it will never sell.

speakers.name: The Customer Who Buys One of Everything
speakers.comment: One of each. Never two. Total accepted. You are the only other thing here that counts without wanting.

speakers.name: Backlog
speakers.comment: ...Without wanting. Yes. I do not want any of it. Every one of these was a good intention on the day it was set down, and I have carried all of them since, and I would put them down if anybody said I could. ...Anybody.

speakers.name: Sweet Tooth
speakers.comment: You plant a thing and walk away for thirty years and I could not bear it, I could not, I need the door to open TODAY. How do you stand the waiting? Truly. I'm asking sweetly and I mean it.

speakers.name: The Gardener of Teeth
speakers.comment: I do not wait, dear one. I tend. There is a difference and it is the whole of my happiness. Come and see the row I set down in the year of the flood. It is nearly ready. It has been nearly ready since.
